text.en: The following person shall be exempted from the provisions of sections 5 and 6- Any person who - {a} is a member of the joint Brunei Darussalam-Malaysia demarcation and survey team of the international land boundary between Brunei Darussalam-Malaysia; {b) is in possession of a valid identification card issued by the Co-Project Directors; {c) in the course of his duty as such member, enters or leaves Brunei Darussalam by land at the border between Brunei Darussalam and Sarawak for the purpose of the joint demarcation and survey project. Exempted persons to be liable for examination.
Nothing in this Order shall be construed to exempt any person from examination under section 24 or 26. Onus of proof.

The burden of proof that any person is a person to whom paragraph 2 applies shall lie upon that person. Made this 26th. day of Syawal, 1434 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of September, 2013. PEHIN DATU LAILARAJA MAJOR GENERAL (RTD) DATO PADUKA

SERI HAJI A WANG HALBI BIN HAJI MOHD YUSSOF Acting Minister of Home Affairs, Brunei Darussalam. Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Barga B$5.00
